# AwesomeSwiftUI

> Copy-paste SwiftUI components, animations and transitions for iOS 18 through iOS 27. Swift 6, MIT. There is no package: download the file of a component and add it to the project. Each component states its minimum iOS.

Search `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/catalog.json` by keyword, in English or Spanish, and fetch the `rawURL` of the match.

## Components

- [Animated Gradient Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/AnimatedGradientBackground/AnimatedGradientBackground.swift): A linear gradient that slowly drifts its colors and turns its direction. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, gradient, linear gradient, animated, colors, drift, fondo, degradado, gradiente, animado, colores, movimiento.
- [Aurora Mesh Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/AuroraMeshBackground/AuroraMeshBackground.swift): An animated aurora background made with a mesh gradient. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, aurora, mesh gradient, gradient, animated, ambient, colors, fondo, aurora, degradado, malla, gradiente, animado, colores.
- [Bubbles Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/BubblesBackground/BubblesBackground.swift): Translucent bubbles that rise and sway across the screen. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, bubbles, underwater, rising, floating, animated, fondo, burbujas, submarino, agua, flotar, animado.
- [Color Orbs Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/ColorOrbsBackground/ColorOrbsBackground.swift): Large, soft colored orbs drifting slowly over a dark base. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, orbs, blur, blobs, glow, ambient, animated, fondo, orbes, difuminado, manchas, brillo, ambiente, animado.
- [Grid Pulse Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/GridPulseBackground/GridPulseBackground.swift): A grid of dots with a pulse of light spreading out from the center. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, grid, dots, pulse, radar, ripple, animated, fondo, cuadrícula, puntos, pulso, radar, onda, animado.
- [Particle Field Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/ParticleFieldBackground/ParticleFieldBackground.swift): Drifting points that are joined by faint lines when they come close. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, particles, constellation, network, points, lines, animated, fondo, partículas, constelación, red, puntos, líneas, animado.
- [Snowfall Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/SnowfallBackground/SnowfallBackground.swift): Snowflakes falling at different speeds across three layers of depth. iOS 18.0+. Backgrounds. Keywords: background, snow, snowfall, winter, flakes, christmas, animated, fondo, nieve, nevada, invierno, copos, navidad, animado.
- [Starfield Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Backgrounds/StarfieldBackground/StarfieldBackground.swift): Stars streaking toward the viewer with a simple perspective projection. iOS 18.0+.
